### Never Too Old
Author: Zondervan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/niv-devotions-for-women/niv-devotions-for-women-week-of-jan-2.html
Passage: Joshua 13:1
Points:
- Believers are never too old to serve the Lord and point others to Jesus.
- Even at an advanced age following decades of leadership and battle, Joshua was not put into retirement.
- God directed Joshua to take on a fresh assignment by overseeing the division of the remaining territories.
- Spiritual gifts do not expire with age, and there are always new spiritual frontiers to pursue.
- Later stages of life provide vital opportunities for mentoring, intercessory prayer, visiting the sick, and sharing the gospel.

### Divide the Conquered!
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/divide-the-conquered
Passage: Joshua 13:7
Points:
- An aging Joshua faced physical exhaustion and uncertainty over whether to allocate land before every region was conquered.
- God intervened with clear direction to resolve Joshua's dilemma without reproaching his inability to keep fighting.
- The Lord promised that Israel would drive out the remaining peoples on the periphery if they faithfully trusted Him in battle.
- Dividing the land by lot highlighted God's sovereign prerogative to distribute tribal inheritances as He saw fit.
- Believers struggling with difficult dilemmas can rely on Scripture and the Holy Spirit for practical guidance.
